            ec = s[i]
            if ec == '"':
                chars.append('"')
                i += 1
            elif ec == '\\':
                chars.append('\\')

            elif ec == '/':
                chars.append('/')

            elif ec == 'b':

            elif ec == 'f':

            elif ec == 'n':

            elif ec == 'r':

                i += 1
            elif ec == 't':

            elif ec == 'u':

                # Parse 4 hex digits

                code = 0

                    else:

                    code = (code << 4) | v
